Spinlock-protected hash table for concurrent access.

Wraps std/tables.Table with a CAS-based spinlock, providing thread-safe get/put/del/iteration without OS-level mutexes. The spinlock never makes a syscall, keeping reactor-thread latency bounded.

Designed for low-contention scenarios (< 1000 entries, short critical sections). All operations hold the lock for O(1) except snapshot/clear which are O(n).
